title: Agent cannot change fields, layouts or field permissions (API)
note: POST field → 403; PUT layout → 403; POST field-permission → 403.

title: Unique across modules
note: qa_uq shared by QA MF Types and QA MF Open: duplicate in same module → 422 "already in use by another record"; same value in the other module → 422 "already in use by a record in QA MF Types"; and back again.

title: Default value
